description: Planscape is a web application for prioritising landscape treatments that reduce wildfire risk. Its README says the U.S. Forest Service and partners combine state and federal layers, map treatment potential using the ForSys model and estimate expected benefits over time. Users select a region and planning constraints; outputs are treatment plans and comparative map views. Geographic coverage is the United States areas represented by source layers. The README says the project is in the U.S. public domain and adopts CC0 worldwide. A limitation is that a treatment plan depends on the supplied fuel, asset and ecology layers, and a modelled benefit is not a measured avoided fire loss. Planscape can support wildfire exposure and adaptation scenarios for power, road and settlement systems. The related QGIS catalogue platform is a general map environment, not this treatment-planning application. No spatial data or container was downloaded.
